client_providers.label: Firm records / Google Sheets
client_providers.purpose: Sources Clients, Leads, Documents_Tracker, Compliance_Calendar, Invoices, Query_Log and Error_Log.
clientProvides: Firm-owned source/table IDs, APIs, field mapping and data owners
Partner-approved deadlines, document state and invoice status
Minimum approved client data and confidentiality review
client_providers.secretDestination: Client-owned n8n Credentials vault; no tax/customer records in public inquiry.
steps: Map the table schema using fictional firm records.
Test lookup misses, stale status and partner approval before any write.

client_providers.label: Gmail / WhatsApp / Telegram (optional)
client_providers.purpose: Captures approved communications and routes human-reviewed drafts/escalations.
clientProvides: Provider documentation, business-owned email/WhatsApp identity and allowed scopes
Partner/team alert destination, consent and message policies
client_providers.secretDestination: OAuth/API credentials in firm-owned n8n Credentials.
steps: Add one least-privilege messaging provider at a time.
Keep outgoing nodes paused until the partner approves the communication.

client_providers.label: Groq or approved OpenAI-compatible AI (optional)
client_providers.purpose: Drafts administrative answers and classifications using only supplied firm facts.
clientProvides: Client-selected compatible endpoint/model, data policy and budget owner
steps: Add the provider credential and approved endpoint through documented configuration.
Test no-advice/no-filing cases and structured-output validation.
